summary: Verified BUG-FIX for owner_token persistence via UI-driven create-season flow. Cleared localStorage, clicked KC team card on Home, clicked start-season-btn, and confirmed nfl_owner_tokens map now contains an entry for the new season id. Navigated to /season/{id}, clicked PLAY MY GAME, game page fully loaded showing Flippy Deck (250/250) and 3D6 dice. Clicked 'Roll & Play' 10 consecutive times — all plays registered, Flippy Deck decremented (250 → 241), play-by-play populated, zero 4xx/5xx API errors and zero 403s observed on network. Fix is working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx line 31 still calls api.post directly instead of using the createSeason() wrapper from lib/api.js. The token is now saved explicitly, but a cleaner fix would be to call createSeason(selected) which already handles saveOwnerToken internally — reduces duplication and prevents this class of bug from recurring.
seed_data_creation: None — created seasons via UI (KC franchise) as part of the test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. UI create-season now correctly stores owner_token in localStorage under key 'nfl_owner_tokens' keyed by season id. Sim-game via 'Roll & Play' works with X-Owner-Token header attached by axios interceptor. Grandfathered-seasons regression (docs without owner_token) was set up (localStorage cleared mid-run) but the PLAY MY GAME navigation on the reloaded season page did not complete within the script's window — backend _load_season_owned grandfather logic was not exercised via UI. Recommend covering that path via a dedicated backend test if needed.
rca of the issue: Home.jsx bypassed the createSeason() wrapper in lib/api.js and called api.post('/season/create') directly, dropping the saveOwnerToken() side-effect. New seasons therefore never had their capability token stored, and subsequent /sim-game and /sim-week POSTs failed the backend ownership check with 403, surfacing to the user as 'Failed to load game'. Fix (already applied by main agent): import saveOwnerToken in Home.jsx and call it with the create response before navigating. Verified via UI flow: token now persists and mutations succeed.
